title: Import the Research Analyst
overview: Add the ready-made Google Research Analyst agent to your workspace from a teammate's share link.

steps.text: Open the email your teammate sent you, find the shared agent, and click Add to my account to import it into your workspace.
Then, click “Accept & copy agent” to add the Google Research Analyst to your account.
To end off, click the Shared tab to view agents shared with your team.
